chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about withdrawal.
He عليه السلام said: “The semen belongs to the man; he may direct it wherever he wishes.”

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام.
key_terms.الْمَاءُ: The semen or reproductive fluid referred to in the ruling.
key_terms.لِلرَّجُلِ: Belonging to the man; indicating his authority in this matter.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ: A narrator who asked the Imam about the ruling.
key_terms.يَصْرِفُهُ: He directs it or disposes of it.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about al-ʿazl (withdrawal) in marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal response from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام concerning al-ʿazl (withdrawal). It indicates that the man has discretion over his semen, and the report is cited in the context of what is permissible and prohibited in marriage.
